name: axis-04-white-slowtop
version_tag: MECHANICAL CALENDAR AXIS — white plate, SUPPORTS STILL OFF, retuned for the TOP thread. axis-03 printed with clean threads at the bottom and broken threads at the top; the cause is layer time, not supports. Above z~28 the nuts and washer are finished, so the bolt prints ALONE as a dia-11 column and each layer collapses to 4.0s — exactly the slow_down_layer_time floor. Measured: bottom thread (dia 24, z0.2-21.7) median 5.5s/layer and printed fine; top thread (dia 11, z74-96.9) median 4.0s/layer and failed. A 1.16mm thread crest cannot solidify in 4s, and it is being driven at outer wall 200mm/s with 5000 accel 97mm up a slender shaft, so vibration compounds it. FIX: slow_down_layer_time 4 -> 18 forces the slicer to stretch small-cross-section layers, which targets the top of the bolt and leaves the fat lower sections alone; outer wall 200 -> 120 and accel 5000 -> 2000 cut ringing on the tall column. This is a deliberate, targeted departure from stock Standard speed — the part is a slender 97mm tower, not a chunky drum. Do NOT respond to broken top threads by re-enabling supports: that packs the thread valleys and was the original failure.
